startHere.title: Soundarya Master Data Management System
startHere.subtitle: MBA and MCA | Populated Master Delivery Portal
startHere.overview: Single source of truth for Soundarya Institute of Management & Science student capability tracking, training delivery, and placement operations.

cards.title: System Rules & Input Conventions
items: Start with 01_Students: Assign permanent student IDs (SIMS_MBA_xxx / SIMS_MCA_xxx) first, then reference them across all operational sheets.
Primary ID Integrity: Duplicate primary IDs are strictly rejected. Stable IDs must be used across all modules.
Input Conventions: Standardized dates, numbers, and currency values across all records.
Missing Data Standard: Missing data must never be treated as zero or blank completion.

cards.title: Entity Structure & Cardinality
items: 01_Students: Enrolled student master profiles for MBA & MCA batches.
02_Assessment_Attempts: Diagnostic, baseline and domain attempts per student.
03_Assessment_Scores: Dimension/competency level breakdown linked to Attempt IDs.
04_Career_Profiles: Career review and readiness evaluation per student.

Job Description – Visual Content & Marketing Associate
Company: Rareminds | Location: Bangalore | Work from Office
Employment Type: Full-Time | Experience: Fresher to 2 Years | Function: Creative & Digital Marketing
Compensation: ₹4,00,000 CTC (Fixed: ₹3,60,000, Variable: ₹40,000 / ₹30,000–₹35,000 gross per month)

About Rareminds:
Rareminds is a learning and career transformation company building a connected Skill Ecosystem for students, educators, institutions, and employers. We help people discover strengths, develop capabilities, demonstrate skills, and access meaningful opportunities.

Role Overview:
Create compelling, consistent visual communication for Rareminds across social media, digital campaigns, events, and sales enablement. Combine graphic design capability with marketing thinking: every creative must address a defined audience, message, and desired action.

Key Responsibilities – Graphic Design & Brand:
• Design on-brand social posts, carousels, posters, thumbnails, banners, and short-form campaign assets.
• Create reusable templates and maintain consistency across typography, layouts, colours, and brand identity.
• Adapt campaign creatives for Instagram, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, web, email, presentations, and print when required.
• Prepare error-free final files with correct sizes, formats, resolution, and naming conventions.

Key Responsibilities – Marketing Campaign Execution:
• Translate briefs into concepts, creative variations, and audience-specific messaging.
• Produce campaign assets for educator engagement, school and college outreach, student onboarding, and Skill Ecosystem promotions.
• Partner with content/growth colleagues on hooks, captions, calls to action, and campaign schedules.
• Support webinars, events, product demos, admissions, registration drives, and sales collateral.

Key Responsibilities – Video & Motion Content:
• Edit short-form videos and reels; add titles, subtitles, motion graphics, and transitions where relevant.
• Create visual storyboards and work with the growth team to package content for strong retention and sharing.
• Resize and repurpose successful creatives across channels.

Key Responsibilities – Performance & Collaboration:
• Track creative deliverables and campaign deadlines using a shared calendar or tracker.
• Review reach, engagement, click-through, and conversions with the growth team; iterate designs based on performance.
• Maintain organised source files, editable templates, and a searchable creative asset library.
• Coordinate with sales, product, and programme teams to ensure accurate claims and clear messaging.

Required Skills:
• Strong graphic design fundamentals: hierarchy, typography, layout, composition, and brand consistency.
• Hands-on knowledge of Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or equivalent tools.
• Ability to execute multiple formats rapidly while maintaining quality and proofreading details.
• Basic video editing and motion graphics capability is desirable.
• An understanding of platform formats, campaign objectives, and audience-specific messaging.

Eligibility & Preferred Experience:
• Any graduate or relevant design/marketing qualification; practical portfolio is essential.
• Fresher to 2 years of experience in graphic design, digital marketing, or content production.
• Experience creating social media campaigns, education-sector creatives, or lead-generation assets is an advantage.

Performance Measures:
• Creative delivery: On-time production against approved briefs and calendar
• Quality & brand: Accuracy, brand consistency, and low rework
• Campaign effectiveness: Engagement, click-through, and conversion contribution
• Asset reuse: Organised source files, templates, and cross-platform adaptations
• Collaboration: Responsiveness to campaign priorities and feedback

Selection Process:
1. Share resume and a portfolio of social media creatives, campaign work, and videos if available.
2. Present 2-3 examples explaining the target audience and intended marketing outcome.
3. Complete a practical brief: one campaign poster, a three-slide carousel, and a reel cover for a Rareminds campaign.
4. Discuss the campaign rationale, brand choices, and proposed call to action.

How to Apply:
Share your resume and portfolio of graphic design and digital marketing work. We value visual thinking that is creative, accurate, audience-aware, and measurable.

Job Description – Finance & Accounts Executive
Company: Rareminds | Team: Management / Finance Head | Location: Bengaluru
Work Mode: Work from office (flexibility required during payroll, collections, statutory filing, audit & month-end closure)
Employment Type: Full-time | Experience: Fresher to 2 years
Qualification: MBA / PGDM in Finance; B.Com + MBA Finance preferred
Office Hours: Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM–5:30 PM | Saturday: 9:00 AM–12:30 PM
Compensation: ₹28,000–₹32,000 gross per month (based on accounting capability and prior experience; performance review after 6 months)

Role Purpose:
The Finance & Accounts Executive will support and progressively own Rareminds' day-to-day accounts, receivables, payables, collections, banking, compliance coordination and financial MIS. The role is expected to go beyond bookkeeping by maintaining financial discipline, highlighting cash-flow risks and providing management with timely, decision-ready information.

Role Structure:
• 30% - Accounts Receivable, Billing & Collections
• 25% - Accounting, Reconciliations & Month-end Closure
• 20% - Accounts Payable, Expenses & Banking
• 15% - Financial MIS, Analysis & Cash-flow Tracking
• 10% - Payroll Support, Compliance & Audit Coordination

Key Responsibilities:
1. Accounts Receivable, Billing & Collections:
• Raise accurate customer invoices with required supporting documentation.
• Maintain customer-wise receivable ledgers and ageing reports.
• Track due dates and follow up professionally for collections.
• Reconcile receipts against invoices and identify short payments or pending deductions.
• Prepare weekly collection forecasts and escalate overdue receivables.
• Maintain account-wise billing, collection and outstanding status for management.

2. Accounts Payable & Expense Management:
• Verify vendor invoices, approvals and supporting documents before payment.
• Maintain vendor ledgers, due-date schedules and payment trackers.
• Coordinate approved payment runs and reconcile vendor statements.
• Review employee reimbursements, advances and settlements.
• Classify and record expenses correctly for accounting and MIS purposes.

3. Accounting, Banking & Reconciliation:
• Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, journals and other accounting entries.
• Perform bank, customer, vendor and ledger reconciliations.
• Support monthly closing, ledger scrutiny and provision entries.
• Maintain proper supporting documentation and audit trails.
• Track bank balances, scheduled payments and expected collections.

4. Financial Analysis & MIS Responsibilities:
• Prepare weekly and monthly MIS covering revenue, collections, receivables, payables, expenses, payroll cost and cash position.
• Prepare receivable ageing and collection-efficiency analysis and identify accounts requiring escalation.
• Track actual expenses against budgets and highlight material variances.
• Prepare project / client / business-unit profitability inputs where data is available.
• Build cash-flow forecasts covering expected inflows, committed outflows and funding gaps.
• Analyse recurring costs and identify opportunities for cost control or process improvement.
• Support management with data for pricing, budgeting, hiring and operating decisions.
• Maintain finance dashboards using Excel / Google Sheets and progressively use Zoho Books reporting capabilities.

5. Payroll, Compliance & Audit Coordination:
• Coordinate with HR for attendance, leave, reimbursement and deduction inputs.
• Coordinate GST, TDS, Professional Tax, PF/ESI and other applicable compliance information with CA/consultants.
• Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and ensure documents are ready before due dates.
• Prepare schedules and supporting documents for statutory and management audits.

Performance Expectations / KPIs:
• Billing: Approved invoices raised accurately within agreed billing cycle.
• Collections: All dues tracked with weekly ageing review and escalation status.
• Accounting Accuracy: Entries and reconciliations complete with supporting documentation (Target: 98%+ accuracy).
• Month-end Closure: Core ledgers and reconciliations completed within 5 working days.
• Cash Visibility: Management can see expected inflows, outflows and gaps via weekly cash-flow view.
• Compliance: Required data and documents shared before statutory due dates with no avoidable late filing.

First 30 / 60 / 90 Day Expectations:
• First 30 Days: Understand Rareminds billing cycles, bank accounts, customers, vendors, accounting systems and current outstanding balances. Validate AR, AP and bank reconciliation status. Take ownership of routine invoicing, payment records and expense documentation.
• By 60 Days: Run weekly receivables, payables and cash-position MIS independently. Complete routine bank and ledger reconciliations with minimal supervision. Maintain a compliance and month-end closure checklist.
• By 90 Days: Own the monthly finance operating rhythm for billing, collections, payments and MIS. Present a monthly finance dashboard with variance explanations and action items. Produce a rolling cash-flow forecast and identify financial risks before they become urgent.

Skills & Tools Expected:
• Strong accounting fundamentals and understanding of P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow.
• Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills: Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, reconciliation formulas and charts.
• Working knowledge of Zoho Books / Tally / equivalent accounting software; Zoho ecosystem exposure preferred.
• Basic knowledge of GST, TDS and statutory compliance workflows.
• Strong numerical accuracy, documentation discipline and confidentiality.
• Ability to follow up with customers and vendors professionally and firmly.
• Analytical mindset: ability to explain what changed, why it matters and what action management should take.

Career Path:
Finance & Accounts Executive → Senior Finance Executive → Assistant Finance Manager → Finance Manager / Finance Controller

opportunities.JD Description:
Job Title: Sales & Business Development Executive
Company: JMR Infotech India Pvt Ltd | Website: https://jmrinfotech.com/
Experience: Internship / 0-2 Years | Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Bengaluru / Mumbai / Chennai / Pune | Work Mode: Hybrid
Working Days: 5 Days (Mon–Fri) | Working Hours: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM
Compensation & CTC:
• Internship Stipend: ₹15,000 per month
• Post Internship & Absorption: ₹3 LPA – ₹6 LPA (depending on experience, skills, and location) + Incentives + Performance Bonus

About JMR Infotech:
JMR is a Leading Oracle Banking and Enterprise Systems Integrator for Global and Regional institutions. The role will primarily focus on IT Sales and engaging with clients and prospects across the APAC region.

About the Role:
We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Business Development Executive to drive business growth through identifying new opportunities, generating leads, and building strong client relationships. The candidate will work closely with the sales and marketing teams to acquire new customers, nurture prospects, and contribute to revenue generation. Upon successful completion of the internship and transition into the role, the candidate will be required to undertake onsite travel to APAC regions as part of business development and client engagement activities.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Business Development:
• Identify and develop new business opportunities through market research, networking, referrals, and digital channels.
• Generate qualified leads through cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, and field visits.
• Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline to achieve monthly and quarterly targets.
• Identify customer needs and recommend suitable enterprise products and banking software services.

2. Sales Management:
• Conduct product presentations and sales demonstrations for prospective banking clients.
• Prepare and deliver sales proposals, quotations, and business presentations.
• Negotiate commercial terms and close business deals.
• Track sales activities and maintain accurate records in CRM systems.

3. Client Relationship Management:
• Establish and maintain strong relationships with clients and key decision-makers.
• Ensure a positive customer experience throughout the sales cycle.
• Follow up with prospects and existing customers to maximize business opportunities.
• Address customer queries and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.

4. Market Intelligence:
• Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and market developments in APAC banking tech.
• Gather customer feedback and provide insights to improve products and services.
• Support the development of market expansion and customer acquisition strategies.

5. Reporting & Coordination:
• Maintain regular sales reports and activity dashboards.
• Provide weekly updates on lead generation, pipeline status, and revenue forecasts.
• Collaborate with marketing, operations, and customer success teams to achieve business objectives.

Required Qualifications:
• MBA in Marketing.
• Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude are encouraged to apply.
• Knowledge of CRM tools is an added advantage.

Required Skills:
• Technical Knowledge: Lead Generation, Prospecting & Cold Calling, Sales Pipeline Management, CRM Tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho CRM), MS Excel, PowerPoint & Reporting.
• Soft Skills: Excellent Communication Skills, Negotiation & Persuasion, Relationship Building, Problem Solving, Presentation Skills, Time Management.
• Preferred Attributes: Self-motivated, customer-centric mindset, energetic and goal-oriented.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
• Number of qualified leads generated.
• Meetings / Demos scheduled.
• Conversion rate from lead to customer.
• Revenue generated & customer acquisition metrics.
• Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.

Mandatory Requirement:
• Valid Passport is mandatory, as the role will involve onsite travel to APAC regions after successful completion of internship and transition into the full-time role.

Career Growth Path:
Sales & Business Development Executive → Senior Executive → Business Development Manager → Regional Sales Manager → Sales Leader
